edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT; EFFECTIVE DATE. The “Effective Date” means the date of the last signature to this Agreement. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [amount to be agreed, subject to client authorization] (the “Settlement Amount”) within [number to be agreed] days after the Effective Date, by wire transfer to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute. This release does not extend to claims unrelated to the Dispute or to rights to enforce this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose those terms to the extent required by law or legal process, as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement, or to its legal, tax, and financial advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations.
